companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Boards as "platform:slug". Examples: greenhouse:gitlab, ashby:ramp, lever:matchgroup, workable:viva, personio:urbansportsclub, breezy:breezy, rippling:rippling. Workday needs tenant, pod and site: workday:nvidia:wd5:NVIDIAExternalCareerSite

careerUrls.title: Career site URLs
careerUrls.description: Careers pages. The platform and board slug are detected from the URL, so you do not need to know which ATS a company uses.

platforms.title: Restrict to platforms
platforms.description: Only crawl these platforms. Leave empty for all enabled ones.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Only return jobs posted within this window. Combined with deduplication, a scheduled run emits only genuinely new jobs.

maxJobs.title: Maximum jobs per run
maxJobs.description: Hard cap on how many jobs this run pushes to the dataset, applied after filtering.

includeDescription.title: Include job descriptions
includeDescription.description: Off is cheaper. Workday and Rippling need a second request per job for the description, so leaving this off avoids thousands of requests.

descriptionType.title: Description format
descriptionType.description: Whether to emit the description as plain text, HTML, or both. Text is smaller and easier to search.

includeContactInfo.title: Include recruiter contact details
includeContactInfo.description: Off by default. Postings sometimes name a recruiter, which is personal data under GDPR. When off, emails and phone numbers are redacted from descriptions.

titleSearch.title: Title contains
titleSearch.description: Match job titles. Use a trailing :* for prefix matching, e.g. Engineer:*

titleExclusionSearch.title: Title excludes
titleExclusionSearch.description: Drop jobs whose title matches any of these. Use a trailing :* for prefix matching.

locationSearch.title: Location contains
locationSearch.description: Keep only jobs whose location matches any of these. Matches raw and normalised location fields.

locationExclusionSearch.title: Location excludes
locationExclusionSearch.description: Drop jobs whose location matches any of these.

descriptionExclusionSearch.title: Description excludes
descriptionExclusionSearch.description: Drop jobs whose title or description matches any of these.

organizationSearch.title: Organization contains
organizationSearch.description: Keep only jobs from companies matching any of these names.

organizationExclusionSearch.title: Organization excludes
organizationExclusionSearch.description: Drop jobs from companies matching any of these names.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: English country names, e.g. Germany, United States, United Kingdom.

employmentTypes.title: Employment type
employmentTypes.description: Keep only these employment types. Derived from the ATS payload, no model needed.

workArrangements.title: Work arrangement
workArrangements.description: Keep only these work arrangements. "Remote OK" means remote with an office available; "Remote Solely" means no office.

experienceLevels.title: Experience level
experienceLevels.description: Keep only these experience brackets, derived from the job title and any stated years of experience.

languages.title: Description language
languages.description: English names, e.g. English, German, French.

hasSalary.title: Only jobs with salary
hasSalary.description: Keep only jobs where a salary figure could be extracted from the posting.

visaSponsorship.title: Only jobs offering visa sponsorship
visaSponsorship.description: Keep only jobs that explicitly state visa sponsorship is available.

datePostedAfter.title: Posted after
datePostedAfter.description: ISO date, e.g. 2026-01-01. Overrides the time range when set.

enrichWithAI.title: AI enrichment (needs your own API key)
enrichWithAI.description: Off by default. Salary, work arrangement, seniority, employment type and language are always extracted for free without a model. This adds key skills, responsibilities and a requirements summary.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API key
anthropicApiKey.description: Only needed when AI enrichment is on. Results are cached per description, so re-runs cost nothing.

enrichmentModel.title: Enrichment model
enrichmentModel.description: Anthropic model used for enrichment. Haiku is the cheapest that does this well.

maxEnrichedJobs.title: Maximum jobs to enrich per run
maxEnrichedJobs.description: Cap on how many new descriptions get sent to the model per run. Cached descriptions do not count.

emitExpiredJobs.title: Detect expired jobs
emitExpiredJobs.description: Jobs that disappeared from a board since the last run are written to the "expired-jobs" dataset. Free, because every run reads the complete board.

enableSmartRecruiters.title: Enable SmartRecruiters (read the note)
enableSmartRecruiters.description: Disabled by default. api.smartrecruiters.com/robots.txt sets "User-agent: * / Disallow: /" and allows only LinkedInBot. Enable this only if you have a lawful basis to crawl it. The decision is recorded in the run log.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many requests run at once across all boards. Per-host crawl delays are still honoured.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The default platforms do not need a proxy.
